source_convention: Start at the first bar's volume; add base volume on a higher close, subtract it on a lower close, and leave OBV unchanged on a flat close.

arithmetic.rule: OBV[0] = volume[0]; higher close adds current volume; lower close subtracts current volume; equal close changes nothing.

source_fields.okx: candle[4] (close) and candle[5] (vol, base-currency quantity for SPOT); never candle[6]/candle[7] quote volume
source_fields.coinbase: candle[4] (close) and candle[5] (volume, base-currency quantity for the spot product)

registry.uncorroborated_note: OBV uses venue-specific base volume, which is not cross-exchange comparable; on a flat close OBV is unchanged. Corroborate the input price bars, not the OBV output.

volume_sources.evidence: For SPOT/MARGIN, vol is quantity in base currency; volCcy and volCcyQuote are quote-currency quantities.
Product candle array field 5 is volume; Coinbase Exchange documents product volume in base-currency units.
